# 一把尺子，两张化验单

<div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:34px;margin:24px 0 2px;flex-wrap:wrap">
<div><span style="font-size:31px;font-weight:700;color:#C22B18;line-height:1">90.9%</span><br><span style="font-size:12px;color:#15171A">瓶装油「酸败或掺假」（20 / 22）</span></div>
<div><span style="font-size:31px;font-weight:700;color:#15171A;line-height:1">2</span><br><span style="font-size:12px;color:#15171A">瓶既纯又没过氧化（共 22 瓶）</span></div>
<div><span style="font-size:31px;font-weight:700;color:#C22B18;line-height:1">88.9%</span><br><span style="font-size:12px;color:#15171A">标牛油果油的食品批次不合格（48 / 54）</span></div>
<div><span style="font-size:31px;font-weight:700;color:#15171A;line-height:1">1 / 20</span><br><span style="font-size:12px;color:#15171A">标橄榄油的食品批次不合格</span></div>
</div>

```{r}
#| label: headline
#| echo: false
# 首屏那段话里的数字也要走 inline R。此块只算这几个头条值（hl_*），
# 后面 setup / prep-* 会按各自的完整口径重新算一遍所有指标。
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(readr); library(dplyr)})
.hb <- read_csv("../data/avocado_oil_bottles.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
.hf <- read_csv("../data/avocado_oil_processed_foods.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

hl_n_av       <- sum(.hf$oil_type == "avocado")
hl_n_av_fail  <- sum(.hf$oil_type == "avocado" & !.hf$authentic)
hl_av_ok      <- hl_n_av - hl_n_av_fail
hl_av_fail_med <- median(.hf$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[.hf$oil_type == "avocado" &
                                                     !.hf$authentic])
hl_av_ok_min  <- min(.hf$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[.hf$oil_type == "avocado" & .hf$authentic])
hl_n_ol       <- sum(.hf$oil_type == "olive")
hl_ol_rng     <- range(.hf$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[.hf$oil_type == "olive"])
hl_n_nonpure  <- sum(.hb$purity_result != "pure")
hl_c161_ok    <- range(.hb$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[.hb$purity_result == "pure"])
hl_c161_bad   <- range(.hb$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[.hb$purity_result == "adulterated"])
hl_n_pure_ok  <- sum(.hb$purity_result == "pure")
```

六年后那 `r hl_n_av_fail` 个不合格的「牛油果油」食品批次，C16:1 棕榈油酸的中位数是 **`r sprintf("%.2f", hl_av_fail_med)`%**，落在橄榄油的位置上。`r hl_n_ol` 个橄榄油批次的区间是 `r sprintf("%.1f", hl_ol_rng[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", hl_ol_rng[2])`%，正好把这个数包住。

对照另一头，`r hl_av_ok` 个真正合格的牛油果油批次全部 ≥ `r sprintf("%.2f", hl_av_ok_min)`%。所以这些产品的问题不是「掺了一点别的油」，而是**几乎不含牛油果油**。

瓶装油那边的同一个指标分得更干脆：纯正 `r sprintf("%.1f", hl_c161_ok[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", hl_c161_ok[2])`%，掺大豆油 `r sprintf("%.1f", hl_c161_bad[1])`%。`r hl_n_nonpure` 个非纯样本全部命中，`r hl_n_pure_ok` 瓶纯正的**一个都没误伤**。

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
  library(ggrepel)
})

# 项目根：从当前目录逐级上溯找 assets/ 标记（与运行位置无关）
find_root <- function() {
  cur <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(cur, "assets"))) return(cur)
    up <- dirname(cur)
    if (identical(up, cur)) stop("未找到含 assets/ 的项目根目录")
    cur <- up
  }
}
root <- find_root()
source(file.path(root, "assets", "tt_theme.R"), encoding = "UTF-8")

# ---- 本周色彩（只在本周生效；共享 theme 不含任何色值）----
# 语义绑定：近黑 = 合格 / 规格内，朱红 = 越界 · 掺假 · 不合格，中性灰 = 没有读数或读数未定性。
# 这四个含义在三张图里不换位，也不与别周同名色复用。
PAL <- list(
  bg   = "#FFFFFF",   # 纯白：整页底色，也是每个面板的底（无卡面）
  ink  = "#15171A",   # 近黑主墨：合格样本、正文、刻度
  red  = "#C22B18",   # 朱红：唯一强调色
  gray = "#9AA0A6"    # 中性灰：未检出 / 未测定 / 未定性
)

# ---- 本周字体决策：两族分工（说人话用 Segoe UI，报数字用 Consolas）----
# 家族数 2 <= TT_FAMILY_MAX = 2。首屏 KPI 不进图，走页面字体栈。
FAM  <- TT_FAMILY[["text"]]
MONO <- TT_FAMILY[["data"]]
mm   <- function(pt) pt / .pt                      # element_text 用 pt，geom_text 用 mm
# 同色透明度（不新增色相）。逐元素可向量化：col 与 a 都会按最长者循环补齐，
# 因为热图矩阵的填充需要「一格一个 alpha」，而 grDevices::adjustcolor 只吃标量。
acol <- function(col, a = 1) {
  m <- grDevices::col2rgb(col)
  n <- max(length(col), length(a))
  m <- m[, rep_len(seq_len(ncol(m)), n), drop = FALSE]
  a <- rep_len(a, n)
  a[!is.finite(a)] <- 1
  sprintf("#%02X%02X%02X%02X", m[1, ], m[2, ], m[3, ], as.integer(round(255 * a)))
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "ragg_png", dpi = TT_EXPORT$dpi,
                      dev.args = list(bg = PAL$bg))

bottles <- read_csv("../data/avocado_oil_bottles.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
foods   <- read_csv("../data/avocado_oil_processed_foods.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ---- 规格尺：Codex Alimentarius 牛油果油参考区间，逐条抄自本周官方 readme ----
# 只收 readme 明确给出数值区间的指标；不给区间的（total_sterols_mg_kg 等）不入尺，
# 因为它们没有「合格带」，硬画进规格走廊就成了自定阈值。
# marker = 短码（热图 13 列装得下的宽度）；name = 平行坐标轴上的全名。
SPEC <- tribble(
  ~marker,    ~name,            ~col,                        ~lo,  ~hi,   ~group,
  "C16:0",    "palmitic",       "c16_0_palmitic_pct",        11.0, 26.0, "fatty acid",
  "C16:1",    "palmitoleic",    "c16_1_palmitoleic_pct",      4.0, 17.1, "fatty acid",
  "C18:0",    "stearic",        "c18_0_stearic_pct",          0.1,  1.3, "fatty acid",
  "C18:1",    "oleic",          "c18_1_oleic_pct",           42.0, 75.0, "fatty acid",
  "C18:2",    "linoleic",       "c18_2_linoleic_pct",         7.8, 19.0, "fatty acid",
  "C18:3",    "linolenic",      "c18_3_linolenic_pct",        0.5,  2.1, "fatty acid",
  "Brassic",  "brassicasterol", "brassicasterol_pct",         0.0,  0.5, "sterol",
  "Campest",  "campesterol",    "campesterol_pct",            4.0,  8.3, "sterol",
  "Stigmas",  "stigmasterol",   "stigmasterol_pct",           0.3,  2.0, "sterol",
  "Clerost",  "clerosterol",    "clerosterol_pct",            1.0,  2.5, "sterol",
  "bSitost",  "b-sitosterol",   "beta_sitosterol_pct",       79.0, 93.4, "sterol",
  "d5-Aven",  "d5-avenasterol", "delta5_avenasterol_pct",     2.0,  8.0, "sterol",
  "d7-Aven",  "d7-avenasterol", "delta7_avenasterol_pct",     0.0,  1.5, "sterol"
) |>
  mutate(
    # 图 1 的轴名用完整一位小数；图 2 的 13 列只有约 0.57 英寸宽，
    # 用去掉多余 .0 的紧凑写法（79.0–93.4 保一位、42.0–75.0 收成 42–75），
    # 全部数值精度都不丢，只是省掉尾随的 .0，才排得下那 13 把尺子。
    spec_lab = sprintf("%.1f\u2013%.1f", lo, hi),
    spec_lab_short = sprintf("%s\u2013%s",
                             if_else(lo == round(lo), sprintf("%.0f", lo), sprintf("%.1f", lo)),
                             if_else(hi == round(hi), sprintf("%.0f", hi), sprintf("%.1f", hi)))
  )

# 平行坐标只用 8 条有区分力、且在 22 瓶里零缺失的轴（13 条全上会把画布挤成条形码）。
# stigmasterol 有 2 瓶缺失，进连线会断成两截，所以改用零缺失的 C16:0 与 bSitost 补位；
# readme 明说是「关键判别指标」的两条（C16:1、C18:3）必须在内。
PC_MARKERS <- c("C16:0", "C16:1", "C18:0", "C18:1", "C18:2", "C18:3",
                "Campest", "bSitost")
```

## 一、先看口径：两张表接不上

```{r}
#| label: prep-caliber
#| echo: false
n_raw_b <- nrow(bottles)                 # 22
n_raw_f <- nrow(foods)                   # 74
stopifnot(n_distinct(bottles$sample_code) == n_raw_b,
          n_distinct(foods$sample_number) == n_raw_f)

# ---- 瓶装油：纯度判定是论文给的离散标签，不是我算的 ----
purity_n <- bottles |> count(purity_result)
n_pure   <- purity_n$n[purity_n$purity_result == "pure"]
n_susp   <- purity_n$n[purity_n$purity_result == "suspected"]
n_adul   <- purity_n$n[purity_n$purity_result == "adulterated"]

n_ox_true  <- sum(bottles$oxidized %in% TRUE)
n_ox_false <- sum(bottles$oxidized %in% FALSE)
n_ox_na    <- sum(is.na(bottles$oxidized))
n_bad_or_ox <- sum(bottles$oxidized %in% TRUE | bottles$purity_result != "pure")
pct_bad_or_ox <- 100 * n_bad_or_ox / n_raw_b
n_clean <- sum(bottles$purity_result == "pure" & bottles$oxidized %in% FALSE)
clean_codes <- sort(bottles$sample_code[bottles$purity_result == "pure" &
                                          bottles$oxidized %in% FALSE])
na_ox_codes <- sort(bottles$sample_code[is.na(bottles$oxidized)])
# 引言与清洗脚本注释写的是 15 只氧化（外部说法，不是本表聚合），
# 用来跟列里的 n_ox_true 对账，差额写进「数据异常」表。
n_intro_ox  <- 15L
n_intro_bad <- n_intro_ox + n_adul
pct_intro_bad <- 100 * n_intro_bad / n_raw_b

# ---- 食品批次：authentic 是策展人按 Codex 规则算好的列，直接引用 ----
n_av   <- sum(foods$oil_type == "avocado")
n_ol   <- sum(foods$oil_type == "olive")
n_av_fail <- sum(foods$oil_type == "avocado" & !foods$authentic)
n_ol_fail <- sum(foods$oil_type == "olive"   & !foods$authentic)
pct_av_fail <- 100 * n_av_fail / n_av
pct_ol_fail <- 100 * n_ol_fail / n_ol
pct_f_fail  <- 100 * sum(!foods$authentic) / n_raw_f
n_products  <- n_distinct(foods$product_id)

# ---- 两表能不能 join：没有共享主键，也没有品牌列 ----
shared_marker_cols <- length(intersect(names(bottles), names(foods)))
n_brand_cols <- sum(str_detect(c(names(bottles), names(foods)),
                               "(?i)brand|manufacturer|company"))
n_shared_key <- length(intersect(bottles$sample_code, as.character(foods$sample_number)))

caliber_tbl <- tribble(
  ~表, ~样本单位, ~行数, ~合格口径, ~不合格口径,
  "avocado_oil_bottles", "一瓶（2020 年 22 个零售瓶装样本）", n_raw_b,
  sprintf("purity_result = pure 且 oxidized = FALSE：%d 行", n_clean),
  sprintf("掺假 %d + 疑似 %d + 已被氧化 %d，占 %d 行",
          n_adul, n_susp, n_ox_true, n_raw_b - n_clean),
  "avocado_oil_processed_foods", "一个批次（37 个产品 × 2 批，2026 年）", n_raw_f,
  sprintf("authentic = TRUE：%d 行", sum(foods$authentic)),
  sprintf("authentic = FALSE：%d 行（标牛油果油 %d、标橄榄油 %d）",
          sum(!foods$authentic), n_av_fail, n_ol_fail)
)
```

本周是两份相隔六年、彼此独立的研究合订。2020 年的瓶装油有 `r n_raw_b` 瓶；2026 年的加工食品有 `r n_raw_f` 个批次，也就是 `r n_products` 个产品各测两批。口径先钉死三件事。

瓶装油的判定栏 `purity_result` 是论文结论的三档：纯正 `r n_pure` 瓶、疑似 `r n_susp` 瓶、确认掺假 `r n_adul` 瓶，掺假的全部是大豆油。疑似指的是谱落在正常牛油果油范围外、但还没定性。

氧化栏 `oxidized` 是另一条独立的轴：**`r n_ox_true` 瓶在保质期前已氧化，`r n_ox_false` 瓶没有**，另外 `r n_ox_na` 瓶没有读数。这 3 个空值不是缺失，说明书写明「确认是大豆油的样本，氧化状态没有意义」。两条轴交叉，既纯又没过氧化的只有 `r n_clean` 瓶（`r paste(clean_codes, collapse = "、")`）。

食品批次的 `authentic` 是策展人按 Codex 区间加 10% 容差算好的判定列，不是我重算的。标牛油果油的 `r n_av` 个批次里 `r n_av_fail` 个不合格，占 `r sprintf("%.1f", pct_av_fail)`%。标橄榄油的 `r n_ol` 个批次里 `r n_ol_fail` 个不合格，占 `r sprintf("%.1f", pct_ol_fail)`%。全表不合格 `r sprintf("%.1f", pct_f_fail)`%。

**两张表能不能 join：不能。** 列名看似有 `r shared_marker_cols` 个化学指标重叠，但那是同一批检测项目，不是同一个体的两次记录。瓶装油的主键是 `sample_code`（`EV1`…），食品的主键是 `sample_number`（1–74），两者交集 `r n_shared_key` 个。

两份数据也都没有品牌 / 厂商列，匹配 `brand|manufacturer|company` 的列数是 `r n_brand_cols`。所以本页不做任何跨表合并，两表只在「用同一把尺子量同一个指标」这个意义上并排阅读。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-caliber
#| echo: false
caliber_tbl |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "本周两张表的口径（行数、合格与不合格的计数口径；两表不可 join，理由见正文）")
```

```{r}
#| label: flow-line
#| echo: false
flow_b  <- tt_flow(n_raw_b, n_raw_b, "全部 22 瓶都进图，0 行剔除")
flow_ox <- tt_flow(n_raw_b, n_raw_b - n_ox_na,
                   sprintf("%d 瓶确认大豆油样本的 oxidized 为 NA（说明书写明此时氧化状态无意义）",
                           n_ox_na))
flow_f  <- tt_flow(n_raw_f, n_raw_f, "全部 74 个批次都进图，0 行剔除")
```

> 入图链：瓶装油 `r flow_b`；氧化率分母 `r flow_ox`；食品批次 `r flow_f`。

## 二、一把尺子量 22 瓶

```{r}
#| label: prep-pc
#| echo: false
# 每轴按自己的 Codex 区间归一：u = (值 - 下限) / (区间宽)。
# u ∈ [0,1] 就是「在规格内」，于是 8 条轴各自的合格带被压成同一条水平走廊——
# 这是平行坐标在这里唯一诚实的用法：轴与轴之间比的是「离规格多远」，不是「数值大小」。
# 区间外用 C1 连续的对数尾展开（u>1 → 1+log(u)；u<0 → −log(1−u)），
# 否则一个大豆油的 C18:2（54.4%）会把其余 21 瓶压成一条直线。
pc <- bottles |>
  select(sample_code, purity_result, oxidized, all_of(SPEC$col)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(SPEC$col), names_to = "col", values_to = "raw") |>
  inner_join(SPEC, by = "col") |>
  filter(marker %in% PC_MARKERS) |>
  mutate(
    x     = match(marker, PC_MARKERS),
    u     = (raw - lo) / (hi - lo),
    g     = if_else(u > 1, 1 + log(u),
            if_else(u < 0, -log(1 - u), u)),
    cls   = factor(purity_result, levels = c("pure", "suspected", "adulterated")),
    # 既纯又没过氧化 = 全周唯一两条真合格线，用主墨加粗单独标出
    clean = purity_result == "pure" & oxidized %in% FALSE
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(pc$g), n_distinct(pc$sample_code) == n_raw_b,
          all(pc$x %in% seq_along(PC_MARKERS)))

spec_axis_lab <- SPEC |>
  filter(marker %in% PC_MARKERS) |>
  mutate(ord = match(marker, PC_MARKERS)) |>
  arrange(ord) |>
  mutate(lab = sprintf("%s\n%s\n%s", marker, name, spec_lab)) |>
  pull(lab)

pc_ylim <- c(min(pc$g, 0) - 0.10, max(pc$g, 1) + 0.10)
n_pc_axes <- length(PC_MARKERS)

# 末端直标：6 个非纯样本 + 2 条真合格线
pc_lab <- pc |>
  filter(x == max(x), cls != "pure" | clean) |>
  mutate(short = case_when(
    purity_result == "adulterated" ~ paste0(sample_code, " soy"),
    purity_result == "suspected"   ~ paste0(sample_code, " suspect"),
    TRUE                           ~ paste0(sample_code, " clean")
  ))
pc_lab_red  <- filter(pc_lab, purity_result == "adulterated")
pc_lab_ink  <- filter(pc_lab, purity_result != "adulterated")

# 「疑似」那 3 瓶究竟哪里出界、哪里干净——正文直接引用，不手打
susp <- filter(bottles, purity_result == "suspected")
susp_c161 <- range(susp$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct)
susp_c180 <- range(susp$c18_0_stearic_pct)
susp_c181 <- range(susp$c18_1_oleic_pct)
susp_c182 <- range(susp$c18_2_linoleic_pct)
susp_camp <- range(susp$campesterol_pct)
susp_bsit <- range(susp$beta_sitosterol_pct)
susp_label <- unique(susp$adulterant)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-corridor
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "All 22 bottles on one Codex ruler: the sixteen pure samples stay inside the shaded corridor, the three soybean bottles leave it on nine to ten of thirteen markers."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 6.0
fig1 <- ggplot(pc, aes(x = x, y = g, group = sample_code)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1, xmax = n_pc_axes, ymin = 0, ymax = 1,
           fill = acol(PAL$ink, 0.055), colour = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), colour = acol(PAL$ink, 0.30),
             linewidth = 0.25, linetype = "22") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = seq_along(PC_MARKERS), colour = acol(PAL$ink, 0.18),
             linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = filter(pc, cls == "pure", !clean),
            colour = acol(PAL$ink, 0.50), linewidth = 0.28) +
  geom_line(data = filter(pc, clean), colour = PAL$ink, linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_line(data = filter(pc, cls == "suspected"),
            colour = acol(PAL$gray, 0.95), linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_line(data = filter(pc, cls == "adulterated"),
            colour = PAL$red, linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = filter(pc, cls != "pure"), colour = PAL$gray, size = 1.4) +
  geom_point(data = filter(pc, cls == "adulterated"), colour = PAL$red, size = 1.4) +
  geom_text_repel(data = pc_lab_red, aes(x = x, y = g, label = short),
                  family = MONO, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]), colour = PAL$red,
                  nudge_x = 0.55, direction = "y", hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
                  segment.colour = acol(PAL$red, 0.75), segment.size = 0.22,
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.16, point.padding = 0.12,
                  xlim = c(8.55, 9.42), max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1006) +
  geom_text_repel(data = pc_lab_ink, aes(x = x, y = g, label = short),
                  family = MONO, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]), colour = PAL$ink,
                  nudge_x = 0.55, direction = "y", hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
                  segment.colour = acol(PAL$ink, 0.55), segment.size = 0.22,
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.16, point.padding = 0.12,
                  xlim = c(8.55, 9.42), max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1007) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(PC_MARKERS), labels = spec_axis_lab,
                     limits = c(0.94, 9.44), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 1), labels = c("spec lo", "spec hi"),
                     limits = pc_ylim, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "One codex ruler, and the three soybean bottles fall straight out",
    subtitle = "Each axis is scaled to its own Codex range-width, so the shaded band is the whole pass zone",
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    caption  = tt_source("avocado_oil_bottles.csv", n_raw_b,
      paste0("every axis reads: marker code / compound name / Codex lower and upper bound. ",
             "A value is placed by (value - lower) / (upper - lower); the out-of-range ",
             "tails are expanded on a log scale only so that one 54 percent linoleic ",
             "reading does not flatten the other 21 bottles, so the axes compare ",
             "distance from spec, never raw magnitude across axes. Thin black lines are ",
             "the 16 pure bottles, the heavy black pair are the only two that are also ",
             "not oxidised, grey is the three suspected sunflower/safflower samples, ",
             "vermilion the three confirmed soybean ones. Grey dashed rules are the ",
             "pass-zone edges, not data."))
  ) +
  tt_base(bg = PAL$bg, ink = PAL$ink, body = PAL$ink, grid = acol(PAL$ink, 0.06),
          family = FAM) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = PAL$bg, colour = NA),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.title       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(family = MONO, colour = PAL$ink,
                                    size = TT_TYPE[["annot"]], lineheight = 1.32),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(family = MONO, colour = PAL$ink,
                                    size = TT_TYPE[["caption"]]),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$ink,
                                    size = TT_TYPE[["subtitle"]], hjust = 0,
                                    margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption     = element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$ink,
                                    size = TT_TYPE[["caption"]], hjust = 0,
                                    margin = margin(t = 12), lineheight = 1.35),
    plot.margin      = margin(16, 20, 12, 16)
  )
fig1
```

**读数**：16 瓶纯正的样本**全部**落在走廊里或紧贴走廊边缘，每瓶越界 0–2 项。3 瓶确认掺大豆油的每一瓶都越界 9–10 项。3 瓶疑似落在 5–7 项。三档之间没有任何重叠，也没有一瓶纯正样本越过 5 项。

所以这条线不是「趋势」而是**分界**。`r n_adul` 瓶大豆油在 C16:1、C18:1、C18:2、C18:3 四条轴上一齐冲出走廊——大豆油的油酸低、亚油酸与亚麻酸高，一眼就能认。

真正值得看的是那 3 瓶「疑似」：它们的**主脂肪酸全部还在规格内**。油酸 `r sprintf("%.1f", susp_c181[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", susp_c181[2])`%，规格 42–75。亚油酸 `r sprintf("%.1f", susp_c182[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", susp_c182[2])`%，规格 7.8–19。

出界的只有三项。C16:1 从下方跌破，`r sprintf("%.1f", susp_c161[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", susp_c161[2])`%，规格下限 4.0。C18:0 从上方超出，`r sprintf("%.1f", susp_c180[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", susp_c180[2])`%，规格上限 1.3。

甾醇一侧同样越界：菜油甾醇 `r sprintf("%.1f", susp_camp[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", susp_camp[2])`% 双双超上限（规格上限 8.3）。

β-谷甾醇 `r sprintf("%.1f", susp_bsit[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", susp_bsit[2])`% 跌破下限（规格下限 79.0）。`adulterant` 栏把这 3 瓶写成 `r susp_label`，正是这个组合指向的油种。

**这就是它们只能判「疑似」而不能判「掺假」的原因：大豆油那三条标志性脂肪酸，它们是干净的。**

不能得出的结论：这张图**不能**说「越界项数 = 掺假程度」。图里只有 22 瓶，且 `purity_result` 是论文的人工判定，越界项数与判定的一致性是我事后对照出来的，不是因果；也不能反过来说「越界 2 项就没事」——`r n_clean` 瓶真合格样本（`r paste(clean_codes, collapse = "、")`）里就有一瓶仍有 2 项越界。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pc
#| echo: false
bottles |>
  select(sample_code, grade_labeled, purity_result, oxidized,
         c16_1_palmitoleic_pct, c18_2_linoleic_pct, c18_3_linolenic_pct,
         campesterol_pct, beta_sitosterol_pct) |>
  arrange(match(purity_result, c("adulterated", "suspected", "pure")), sample_code) |>
  transmute(`样本` = sample_code, `标签等级` = grade_labeled, `判定` = purity_result,
            `已氧化` = if_else(is.na(oxidized), "无读数", if_else(oxidized, "是", "否")),
            `C16:1 %` = sprintf("%.1f", c16_1_palmitoleic_pct),
            `C18:2 %` = sprintf("%.1f", c18_2_linoleic_pct),
            `C18:3 %` = sprintf("%.1f", c18_3_linolenic_pct),
            `菜油甾醇 %` = sprintf("%.1f", campesterol_pct),
            `β-谷甾醇 %` = sprintf("%.1f", beta_sitosterol_pct)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "图 1 的原始数字（22 瓶全列；「已氧化」的「无读数」= 确认大豆油样本，说明书写明此时氧化状态无意义）")
```

## 三、六项全中，但硬脂酸误伤四瓶纯正样本

```{r}
#| label: prep-heat
#| echo: false
# 逐格算「离规格多远」，带符号、以区间宽为单位：
#   高于上限 → +（值−上限）/区间宽；低于下限 → −（值−下限）/区间宽；在区间内 → 0；未检出 → NA。
# 用区间宽而不是标准差分，是因为 22 瓶里 3 瓶的大豆油数值极端，
# 标准差会被这 3 瓶自己撑大，越界反而看不出来。
dev <- bottles |>
  select(sample_code, purity_result, oxidized, all_of(SPEC$col)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(SPEC$col), names_to = "col", values_to = "raw") |>
  inner_join(SPEC, by = "col") |>
  mutate(
    side = case_when(is.na(raw) ~ NA_character_,
                     raw > hi   ~ "+",
                     raw < lo   ~ "-",
                     TRUE       ~ "0"),
    dev  = case_when(is.na(raw) ~ NA_real_,
                     raw > hi   ~ (raw - hi) / (hi - lo),
                     raw < lo   ~ (raw - lo) / (hi - lo),
                     TRUE       ~ 0),
    out  = !is.na(side) & side != "0"
  )

n_marks_used <- n_distinct(dev$marker)
stopifnot(n_marks_used == nrow(SPEC), nrow(dev) == n_raw_b * nrow(SPEC))

row_ord <- dev |>
  summarise(n_out = sum(out), .by = c(sample_code, purity_result)) |>
  arrange(match(purity_result, c("adulterated", "suspected", "pure")),
          desc(n_out), sample_code)

n_det_by_sample <- dev |> filter(!is.na(side)) |> summarise(n = n(), .by = sample_code)

per_marker <- dev |>
  summarise(n_flag = sum(out), n_det = sum(!is.na(side)), .by = c(marker, group)) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n_flag / n_det) |>
  arrange(desc(n_flag), marker)

# 单项判别力：找出「6 个非纯全中 + 16 瓶纯正零误伤」的指标，并对误伤做记录
marker_wrong <- dev |>
  summarise(n_flag = sum(out), .by = c(marker, purity_result)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = purity_result, values_from = n_flag, values_fill = 0)
perfect_markers <- marker_wrong |>
  filter(adulterated == n_adul, suspected == n_susp, pure == 0) |>
  pull(marker)
# 误伤瓶数：marker_wrong$marker 用的是 SPEC$marker 的短码（C18:0 / Stigmas / Campest），
# 不是原始列名。用短码取，取不到就直接停——否则 inline R 会静默渲染成空串。
fp_of <- function(code) {
  v <- marker_wrong$pure[marker_wrong$marker == code]
  if (length(v) != 1L) stop("误伤计数取不到：", code)
  v
}
fp_stearic <- fp_of("C18:0")
fp_stig    <- fp_of("Stigmas")
fp_camp    <- fp_of("Campest")
stopifnot(length(perfect_markers) >= 1,
          fp_stearic > 0, fp_stig > 0, fp_camp > 0)

# 正文与图注里用短码（marker_wrong 按 marker 分组，本身已经是短码）；
# 正文是中文用「与」，图内文字一律英文用 and。
perfect_codes <- perfect_markers
perfect_zh <- paste(perfect_codes, collapse = " 与 ")
perfect_en <- paste(perfect_codes, collapse = " and ")
n_perfect  <- length(perfect_codes)

# 两条零误伤指标的端点值（正文直接引用，不手打）
bs_pure_min <- min(bottles$beta_sitosterol_pct[bottles$purity_result == "pure"])
bs_adul_max <- max(bottles$beta_sitosterol_pct[bottles$purity_result == "adulterated"])
c161_pure_rng <- range(bottles$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[bottles$purity_result == "pure"])
c161_susp_rng <- range(bottles$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[bottles$purity_result == "suspected"])

x_first <- 2
x_last  <- x_first + n_marks_used - 1
x_strip <- 0.55
x_cnt   <- x_last + 1.35
n_rows  <- nrow(row_ord)

hm_y <- function(code) as.numeric(factor(code, levels = rev(row_ord$sample_code)))

hm <- dev |>
  mutate(
    y    = hm_y(sample_code),
    x    = x_first + as.numeric(factor(marker, levels = SPEC$marker)) - 1,
    a    = case_when(is.na(dev) ~ NA_real_,
                     abs(dev) <= 0.25 ~ 0.30,
                     abs(dev) <= 1.00 ~ 0.55,
                     abs(dev) <= 2.50 ~ 0.78,
                     TRUE             ~ 1.00),
    fill = case_when(is.na(side) ~ acol(PAL$gray, 0.20),
                     side == "0" ~ PAL$bg,
                     TRUE        ~ acol(PAL$red, coalesce(a, 1))),
    txt  = case_when(is.na(side) ~ "nd",
                     side == "0" ~ "",
                     abs(dev) < 0.10 ~ sprintf("%+.2f", dev),
                     TRUE        ~ sprintf("%+.1f", dev)),
    tcol = case_when(is.na(side) ~ PAL$gray,
                     side == "0" ~ PAL$ink,
                     a >= 0.55   ~ "#FFFFFF",
                     TRUE        ~ PAL$red)
  )

verdict_fill <- c(adulterated = PAL$red, suspected = PAL$gray, pure = PAL$ink)
cls_of_row <- row_ord |>
  mutate(y = hm_y(sample_code),
         fill_col = unname(verdict_fill[purity_result]))
out_of_sample <- row_ord |> mutate(y = hm_y(sample_code))

# 表头分三层（都在面板内、矩阵上方）：
#   tier A（最高）分组名 class / fatty acids / sterols / out of spec
#   tier B  每列自己的 Codex 区间 —— 这就是本周的「规格尺」，13 列各压一把
#   tier C  面板外的 top 轴 = 指标短码
# 三层分开放，是因为 13 列的列宽只有约 0.57 英寸，
# 短码 + 区间挤在同一行会连成一片（第一版就是这么崩的）。
hm_col_lab <- SPEC$marker
spec_ruler <- tibble(x = seq(x_first, x_last), y = n_rows + 0.78,
                     lab = SPEC$spec_lab_short)
group_band <- tibble(x = c(x_strip, (x_first + x_first + 5) / 2,
                           (x_first + 6 + x_last) / 2, x_cnt),
                     y = n_rows + 1.34,
                     lab = c("class", "fatty acids", "sterols", "out of spec"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-matrix
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Nine to ten of thirteen markers move at once on each soybean bottle, five to seven on each suspected one, and at most two on any pure bottle."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 6.4
fig2 <- ggplot(hm, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = fill), colour = acol(PAL$ink, 0.34), linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = txt, colour = tcol), family = MONO,
            size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]), fontface = "bold") +
  geom_tile(data = cls_of_row, aes(x = x_strip, y = y, fill = fill_col),
            width = 0.46, height = 1, colour = NA) +
  geom_text(data = out_of_sample,
            aes(x = x_cnt, y = y, label = sprintf("%d", n_out)),
            family = MONO, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]), colour = PAL$ink,
            fontface = "bold") +
  geom_text(data = spec_ruler, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
            family = MONO, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]),
            colour = acol(PAL$ink, 0.85), vjust = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  annotate("segment", x = x_first + 5.5, xend = x_first + 5.5,
           y = 0.45, yend = n_rows + 1.58, colour = acol(PAL$ink, 0.35),
           linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = group_band, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
            family = FAM, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]), colour = PAL$ink,
            fontface = "bold", vjust = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(x_first, x_last), labels = hm_col_lab,
                     limits = c(0.15, x_cnt + 0.85), expand = c(0, 0),
                     position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = hm_y(row_ord$sample_code),
                     labels = row_ord$sample_code,
                     limits = c(0.40, n_rows + 1.80), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Two columns separate every non-pure bottle from every pure one",
    subtitle = "Signed distance outside the Codex range, in range-widths; empty cell = inside spec, nd = not detected",
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    caption  = tt_source("avocado_oil_bottles.csv", n_raw_b,
      sprintf(paste0("13 Codex markers x 22 bottles, every cell measured against that ",
                     "marker's own range: +3.2 means 3.2 range-widths above the upper ",
                     "bound. nd marks a compound below detection, which is not a violation ",
                     "and is never counted as zero. The left strip is the paper's purity ",
                     "verdict, the right column counts violations among the markers ",
                     "actually detected (10-12 per bottle), so two bottles are not scored ",
                     "out of the same denominator. Filled cells are shaded by magnitude ",
                     "only; %s are the only markers that violate on all %d non-pure bottles ",
                     "and on none of the %d pure ones."),
              perfect_en, n_adul + n_susp, n_pure))
  ) +
  tt_base(bg = PAL$bg, ink = PAL$ink, body = PAL$ink, grid = acol(PAL$ink, 0.06),
          family = FAM) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = PAL$bg, colour = NA),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.title       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(family = MONO, colour = PAL$ink,
                                    size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(family = MONO, colour = PAL$ink,
                                    size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$ink,
                                    size = TT_TYPE[["subtitle"]], hjust = 0,
                                    margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption     = element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$ink,
                                    size = TT_TYPE[["caption"]], hjust = 0,
                                    margin = margin(t = 12), lineheight = 1.35),
    plot.margin      = margin(16, 20, 12, 16)
  )
fig2
```

**读数**：13 项规格，每瓶实际检出 `r min(n_det_by_sample$n)`–`r max(n_det_by_sample$n)` 项。**只有 `r perfect_zh` 两条指标做到「6 个非纯全中、16 瓶纯正零误伤」。**

C16:1 最干脆。纯正 `r sprintf("%.1f", c161_pure_rng[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", c161_pure_rng[2])`%。疑似 `r sprintf("%.1f", c161_susp_rng[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", c161_susp_rng[2])`%，掺假那一档只有 0.1%。

三档之间没有任何重叠。β-谷甾醇次之，纯正最低 `r sprintf("%.1f", bs_pure_min)`%、掺假最高 `r sprintf("%.1f", bs_adul_max)`%。

反倒是几条常被当作「掺假指纹」的指标会误伤。C18:0 硬脂酸把 `r fp_stearic` 瓶纯正样本也标成越界，豆甾醇误伤 `r fp_stig` 瓶，菜油甾醇误伤 `r fp_camp` 瓶。

**所以看单一指标会被假阳性带偏，看越界项数才稳。** `r n_adul` 瓶大豆油越界 `r paste(range(row_ord$n_out[row_ord$purity_result == "adulterated"]), collapse = "–")` 项。`r n_pure` 瓶纯正只越界 `r paste(range(row_ord$n_out[row_ord$purity_result == "pure"]), collapse = "–")` 项，两档之间的空隙比任何单一指标都宽。

不能得出的结论：`nd`（未检出）的格子**不是 0**，它只是「低于检出限」，所以每瓶的分母不同。正文只比「几项」不比「占几成」，不能拿 10/13 和 9/11 直接比大小。这也是我没有把 `total_sterols_mg_kg` 放进尺子的原因：readme 没给它区间，硬编一个阈值就成了自定标准。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-matrix
#| echo: false
per_marker |>
  transmute(`指标` = marker, `族` = group,
            `检出样本数` = n_det, `越界样本数` = n_flag,
            `越界比例` = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "图 2 的列合计（每项在 22 瓶里检出几瓶、越界几瓶；「越界比例」的分母是检出样本数，不是 22）")
```

## 四、六年后，食品批次落在橄榄油的位置

```{r}
#| label: prep-strip
#| echo: false
# 点条只用一条轴（C16:1），因为它是第三节里零误伤的判别指标；
# x 取 log 是为了让 0.1–2.2 这一段（合格与不合格首先在那里混着）看得清，
# 4.0 的合格下限落在 log 轴上一个固定位置。
set.seed(1006)
foods_pts <- foods |>
  mutate(
    oil_f   = factor(if_else(oil_type == "avocado", "declared avocado oil",
                             "declared olive oil"),
                     levels = c("declared avocado oil", "declared olive oil")),
    cat_f   = factor(category, levels = c("chips", "mayonnaise", "salad_dressing"),
                     labels = c("chips", "mayonnaise", "salad dressing")),
    cat_num = as.numeric(cat_f),
    verdict = if_else(authentic, "authentic", "failed"),
    y       = cat_num + runif(n(), -0.20, 0.20)
  )

grp_tbl <- foods_pts |>
  summarise(n = n(), n_fail = sum(!authentic),
            med = median(c16_1_palmitoleic_pct),
            mn  = min(c16_1_palmitoleic_pct),
            mx  = max(c16_1_palmitoleic_pct),
            .by = c(oil_f, cat_f, cat_num)) |>
  arrange(oil_f, cat_num)

AV_FLOOR <- SPEC$lo[SPEC$marker == "C16:1"]      # 4.0，抄自 readme 的 Codex 牛油果油下限
n_av_ok        <- n_av - n_av_fail
n_av_fail_below <- sum(foods$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[foods$oil_type == "avocado" &
                                                     !foods$authentic] < AV_FLOOR)
av_ok_min    <- min(foods$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[foods$oil_type == "avocado" & foods$authentic])
av_fail_med  <- median(foods$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[foods$oil_type == "avocado" & !foods$authentic])
ol_rng       <- range(foods$c16_1_palmitoleic_pct[foods$oil_type == "olive"])
av_fail_lin  <- median(foods$c18_2_linoleic_pct[foods$oil_type == "avocado" & !foods$authentic])
chips_av_ok  <- sum(foods$category == "chips" & foods$oil_type == "avocado" & foods$authentic)
chips_av_n   <- sum(foods$category == "chips" & foods$oil_type == "avocado")
mayo_av_ok   <- sum(foods$category == "mayonnaise" & foods$oil_type == "avocado" & foods$authentic)
mayo_av_n    <- sum(foods$category == "mayonnaise" & foods$oil_type == "avocado")
dress_av_n   <- sum(foods$category == "salad_dressing" & foods$oil_type == "avocado")
ol_fail_decl <- sprintf("%s", foods$declared_oil[foods$oil_type == "olive" & !foods$authentic])
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-strip
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Under the avocado-oil label, the failing lots sit exactly where olive oil sits; only six avocado lots clear the 4.0 percent palmitoleic floor."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 5.6
fig3 <- ggplot(foods_pts, aes(x = c16_1_palmitoleic_pct, y = y)) +
  geom_segment(data = tibble(oil_f = factor("declared avocado oil",
                                            levels = levels(foods_pts$oil_f)),
                             x = AV_FLOOR, xe = AV_FLOOR, y = 0.50, ye = 3.70),
               aes(x = x, xend = xe, y = y, yend = ye),
               colour = PAL$red, linewidth = 0.42, linetype = "22",
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = verdict), size = 1.75, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = filter(foods_pts, verdict == "failed"),
             aes(x = c16_1_palmitoleic_pct, y = y), shape = 1,
             colour = PAL$red, size = 2.55, stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = filter(grp_tbl, n_fail > 0),
            aes(x = 8.7, y = cat_num, label = sprintf("%d of %d failed", n_fail, n)),
            family = MONO, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]), colour = PAL$red,
            hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = filter(grp_tbl, n_fail == 0),
            aes(x = 8.7, y = cat_num, label = sprintf("%d of %d failed", n_fail, n)),
            family = MONO, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]), colour = PAL$ink,
            hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = tibble(oil_f = factor("declared avocado oil",
                                         levels = levels(foods_pts$oil_f)),
                          x = AV_FLOOR * 0.93, y = 3.55,
                          lab = sprintf("Codex floor %.1f%%", AV_FLOOR)),
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
            family = MONO, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]), colour = PAL$red,
            hjust = 1, vjust = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ oil_f, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(authentic = PAL$ink, failed = PAL$red),
                      breaks = c("authentic", "failed"),
                      labels = c("authentic (profile consistent)",
                                 "failed (profile inconsistent)"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
                     labels = c("0.1", "0.5", "1", "2", "4", "8"),
                     limits = c(0.075, 9.6), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:3,
                     labels = c("chips", "mayonnaise", "salad dressing"),
                     limits = c(0.45, 3.75), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Most 'avocado oil' food lots carry no avocado-oil signal at all",
    subtitle = "C16:1 palmitoleic acid as percent of total fatty acids, one dot per lot; 74 lots of 37 products, two lots each",
    x = "C16:1 palmitoleic acid (% of total fatty acids, log scale)", y = NULL,
    caption  = tt_source("avocado_oil_processed_foods.csv", n_raw_f,
      sprintf(paste0("each dot is one lot and the ring marks lots the curator's Codex rule ",
                     "calls inconsistent with the declared oil. All %d authentic avocado ",
                     "lots sit at or above the %.1f floor (minimum %.1f), while %d of the %d ",
                     "failing avocado lots sit below it, median %.2f - inside the band the ",
                     "%d olive lots occupy (%.1f-%.1f). Palmitoleic acid is one of the ",
                     "markers that rule uses, so this is where the failures sit, not ",
                     "independent proof of why they were flagged. The dashed floor applies to ",
                     "the avocado panel only."),
              n_av_ok, AV_FLOOR, av_ok_min, n_av_fail_below, n_av_fail,
              av_fail_med, n_ol, ol_rng[1], ol_rng[2]))
  ) +
  tt_base(bg = PAL$bg, ink = PAL$ink, body = PAL$ink, grid = acol(PAL$ink, 0.06),
          family = FAM) +
  theme(
    panel.background    = element_rect(fill = PAL$bg, colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major.y  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_line(colour = acol(PAL$ink, 0.07), linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.title.x        = element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$ink,
                                       size = TT_TYPE[["axis_title"]]),
    axis.text.x         = element_text(family = MONO, colour = PAL$ink,
                                       size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]),
    axis.text.y         = element_text(family = MONO, colour = PAL$ink,
                                       size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]),
    strip.background    = element_blank(),
    strip.text          = element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$ink, hjust = 0,
                                       size = TT_TYPE[["axis_title"]], face = "bold",
                                       margin = margin(b = 6)),
    legend.position     = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.text         = element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$ink,
                                       size = TT_TYPE[["annot"]]),
    legend.key.spacing.x = unit(6, "pt"),
    legend.margin       = margin(b = 6),
    plot.subtitle       = element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$ink,
                                       size = TT_TYPE[["subtitle"]], hjust = 0,
                                       margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption        = element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$ink,
                                       size = TT_TYPE[["caption"]], hjust = 0,
                                       margin = margin(t = 12), lineheight = 1.35),
    plot.margin         = margin(16, 20, 12, 16)
  )
fig3
```

**读数**：`r n_av_ok` 个合格的牛油果油批次**全部**在 `r sprintf("%.1f", AV_FLOOR)` 线上或以上，最低 `r sprintf("%.1f", av_ok_min)`。

另一头，`r n_av_fail` 个不合格批次里有 `r n_av_fail_below` 个跌破这条线，中位数只有 `r sprintf("%.2f", av_fail_med)`。这个数正好落在 `r n_ol` 个橄榄油批次所在的 `r sprintf("%.1f", ol_rng[1])`–`r sprintf("%.1f", ol_rng[2])` 区间里。

分品类看，**薯片最惨**：`r chips_av_n` 个标牛油果油的批次只有 `r chips_av_ok` 个合格。蛋黄酱 `r mayo_av_n` 个里 `r mayo_av_ok` 个合格，沙拉酱 `r dress_av_n` 个则全军覆没。

橄榄油那一侧 `r n_ol` 个批次只有 `r n_ol_fail` 个不合格，是一个标 `r ol_fail_decl` 的薯片批次。

所以本周真正的对照不是「牛油果油 vs 橄榄油」，而是「有监管的品类 vs 没监管的品类」。**同一条 Codex 尺子、同一批实验室、同一个年份**，橄榄油 `r sprintf("%.0f", pct_ol_fail)`% 不合格，牛油果油 `r sprintf("%.0f", pct_av_fail)`% 不合格。

不能得出的结论：**不能**说这些产品「掺了大豆油」。掺大豆油会把 C18:2 亚油酸推到 50% 以上（瓶装油那 3 瓶就是 54–55%），而这里的失败批次 C18:2 中位数只有 `r sprintf("%.1f", av_fail_lin)`%，差着一个量级。数据只能说到「这些批次的指纹与它声明的油种不符」，具体换成了哪一种油、换了几成，这两张表都答不了。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-strip
#| echo: false
grp_tbl |>
  transmute(`声明油种` = as.character(oil_f), `品类` = as.character(cat_f),
            `批次数` = n, `不合格` = n_fail,
            `不合格率` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n_fail / n),
            `C16:1 中位数` = sprintf("%.2f", med),
            `C16:1 区间` = sprintf("%.1f–%.1f", mn, mx)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "图 3 的原始数字（按声明油种 × 品类；「C16:1 区间」是该组全部批次的最小–最大）")
```

## 五、氧化和纯度互不相干

```{r}
#| label: prep-ox
#| echo: false
ox_tbl <- bottles |>
  mutate(ox_lab = case_when(is.na(oxidized) ~ "no reading",
                            oxidized ~ "oxidised",
                            TRUE ~ "not oxidised"),
         ox_lab  = factor(ox_lab, levels = c("oxidised", "not oxidised", "no reading")),
         pur_lab = factor(purity_result, levels = c("pure", "suspected", "adulterated"))) |>
  count(pur_lab, ox_lab) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = ox_lab, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

ox_by_class <- bottles |>
  mutate(ox_lab = case_when(is.na(oxidized) ~ "no reading",
                            oxidized ~ "oxidised",
                            TRUE ~ "not oxidised")) |>
  summarise(n = n(), n_ox = sum(ox_lab == "oxidised"), .by = purity_result) |>
  mutate(pct = 100 * n_ox / n)

pct_ox_measured <- 100 * n_ox_true / (n_ox_true + n_ox_false)

price_tbl <- bottles |>
  summarise(n = n(), min = min(cost_per_fl_oz), med = median(cost_per_fl_oz),
            max = max(cost_per_fl_oz), .by = purity_result) |>
  arrange(match(purity_result, c("adulterated", "suspected", "pure")))

pr <- bottles$cost_per_fl_oz
price_all  <- sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", min(pr), max(pr))
ch_clean   <- bottles$cost_per_fl_oz[bottles$purity_result == "pure" &
                                       bottles$oxidized %in% FALSE]
ch_adul    <- bottles$cost_per_fl_oz[bottles$purity_result == "adulterated"]
n_ox_pure  <- ox_by_class$n_ox[ox_by_class$purity_result == "pure"]
n_ox_susp  <- ox_by_class$n_ox[ox_by_class$purity_result == "suspected"]
```

**氧化和纯度几乎不相关。** 在 `r n_raw_b` 瓶里，`r n_ox_true` 瓶在保质期前已氧化。按有读数的 `r n_ox_true + n_ox_false` 瓶算，氧化率是 `r sprintf("%.1f", pct_ox_measured)`%。

纯正组 `r n_ox_pure`/`r n_pure` 氧化。疑似组 `r n_ox_susp`/`r n_susp` 氧化。掺假不掺假，该氧化的还是氧化了，两条轴交叉后只剩 `r n_clean` 瓶过关。

**价格也不区分真伪。** 22 瓶的价格带是 $`r price_all` 每液量盎司，跨度接近 10 倍。

但掺大豆油的 3 瓶全在 $`r sprintf("%.2f", min(ch_adul))`–$`r sprintf("%.2f", max(ch_adul))`。真合格的 2 瓶则落在 $`r sprintf("%.2f", min(ch_clean))`–$`r sprintf("%.2f", max(ch_clean))`，两头挤在同一个低价区间。

最贵的两瓶（$2.23、$2.35，都是 extra virgin）确实纯正，可纯正组从 $`r sprintf("%.2f", min(pr))` 一路铺到 $`r sprintf("%.2f", max(pr))`。换言之：**贵的不一定假，但便宜的两头都有**。

n = 22 且是 2020 年一次采购的快照，这条只能当描述，不能外推成「价格与真伪无关」的结论。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ox
#| echo: false
ox_tbl |>
  rename(`判定` = pur_lab) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "氧化 × 纯度交叉表（22 瓶全列；「no reading」= 3 瓶确认大豆油样本，说明书写明此时氧化状态无意义，不是缺失）")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-price
#| echo: false
price_tbl |>
  transmute(`判定` = purity_result, `瓶数` = n,
            `最低价` = sprintf("%.2f", min), `中位价` = sprintf("%.2f", med),
            `最高价` = sprintf("%.2f", max)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "价格分布（美元 / 液量盎司）按纯度判定分组；三组区间互相覆盖，没有一档单靠价格可分离")
```

## 数据异常（记录，不改数据）

| 现象 | 原始数字 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 「氧化」计数与引言口径不一致 | 引言与清洗脚本注释都写「15 只样本在保质期前氧化」，但列里 `oxidized = TRUE` 是 **`r n_ox_true`** 瓶（`r n_ox_pure` 瓶纯正 + `r n_ox_susp` 瓶疑似）；按引言口径「酸败或掺假」= `r n_intro_bad`/`r n_raw_b`（`r sprintf("%.1f", pct_intro_bad)`%），按列算是 **`r n_bad_or_ox`/`r n_raw_b`（`r sprintf("%.1f", pct_bad_or_ox)`%）** | 不改数。正文与 KPI 一律用列口径并注明「按列重算」，不引用引言那个百分比 |
| `oxidized` 的 3 个空值不是缺失 | `r paste(na_ox_codes, collapse = "、")` 三瓶确认大豆油样本全为 `NA` | 说明书写明此时氧化状态无意义；氧化率分母取 `r n_ox_true + n_ox_false` 瓶而非 22 瓶，图 1 里这三瓶单独用灰红区分 |
| `grade_labeled` 是派生列 | 由 `sample_code` 前缀（EV / R / U）反推，不是瓶上另记的字段 | 保留原值但不当作独立证据：`r n_adul` 瓶掺假里有 `r sum(bottles$grade_labeled[bottles$purity_result == "adulterated"] == "extra virgin")` 瓶标着 extra virgin |
| 食品表 6 列整列为空 | `c6_0_pct`、`c8_0_pct`、`c10_0_pct`、`c20_2_pct`、`c24_1_pct`（读成 logical，全 `NA`）、`c12_0_pct`（double，全 `NA`）—— 74/74 缺失 | 一律不用、也不当 0：既可能是「未检出」也可能是「未检测」，两表之间无法区分 |
| 食品表甾醇列大面积缺失 | `apparent_beta_sitosterol_pct` 缺 54/74、`c14_0_pct` 缺 53/74、`brassicasterol_pct` 缺 52/74、`c17_0_pct` 缺 47/74 | 不插补。缺得少的列照用，缺过半的列不进任何图，只在表里出现 |
| `authentic` 是派生列，不是实测 | 由脂肪酸 + 甾醇指纹按 Codex 区间（10% 容差）算出的判定 | 直接引用策展人的列；图 3 的 C16:1 本身就在那条规则里，因此图 3 的读数**不是独立验证**，正文已写明 |
| 两张表无法 join | 共享主键 0 个；`sample_code`（EV1…）与 `sample_number`（1–74）无交集；两表均无品牌列 | 不合并、不假设「同一品牌」。跨表只做「同一把尺子量同一指标」的并排，不做逐产品追溯 |
| 产地不是单值 | `product_origin` 有「Mexico, USA, or Spain」（3 瓶）、「Spain or Mexico」（1 瓶）这类多值标签 | 不按产地聚合；产地只在表里出现 |
| 保质期是字符串 | `expiration_date` 形如 `Oct-21`（按月、无日），且 2 瓶为空 | 不转日期、不参与任何时间轴；本页不用它 |
| 食品表有混合声明 | `r n_ol` 个橄榄油批次里有 2 个声明「Refined Olive Pomace Oil, Extra Virgin Olive Oil」 | `oil_type` 一律按策展人的 olive；不把油渣油拆出来单算 |
| 样本量太小，不能外推 | 瓶装 22 瓶；食品 74 个批次 = `r n_products` 个产品，单组最少只有 4 个批次 | 全页不做回归、不做分类器、不报 p 值；所有比较是逐样本 / 逐组计数，结论自带「在这 22 瓶 / 这 74 个批次里」的限定 |

## 方法与口径

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 数据 | `data/avocado_oil_bottles.csv`（`r n_raw_b` × `r ncol(bottles)`，`sample_code` 唯一）＋ `data/avocado_oil_processed_foods.csv`（`r n_raw_f` × `r ncol(foods)`，`sample_number` 唯一） |
| 覆盖 | 瓶装：`r n_distinct(bottles$grade_labeled)` 个标签等级、`r n_distinct(bottles$packaging_type)` 种包装、`r n_distinct(bottles$product_origin)` 种产地写法；食品：`r n_distinct(foods$category)` 个品类 × `r n_distinct(foods$oil_type)` 个油种，`r n_distinct(foods$purchase_location)` 个采购渠道 |
| 入图样本 | 瓶装油 `r flow_b`；食品批次 `r flow_f`；氧化率分母 `r flow_ox` |
| 图 1 口径 | 8 条有 Codex 区间的轴，每轴按 `(值−下限)/(上限−下限)` 归一，`[0,1]` 即合格带；区间外做对数尾展开（只为压缩 1 个 54% 读数，不改排序）；灰虚线是合格带边界，不是数据 |
| 图 2 口径 | 13 条 Codex 区间逐条抄自本周 readme；格值 = 带符号的「离规格多少个区间宽」；`nd` = 未检出，单列一色，不参与越界计数 |
| 图 3 口径 | 只用 C16:1 一条轴（第三节里唯一零假阳性的指标）；横轴 log10 只为展开 0.1–2.2 这段；红虚线是 Codex 牛油果油下限 4.0，只对「声明牛油果油」面板有约束力 |
| 不作为证据的列 | `total_sterols_mg_kg` / `total_tocopherols_mg_kg`（readme 不给区间，做不出合格带）；食品表 `c6_0`–`c12_0`、`c20_2`、`c24_1`（整列为空）；`expiration_date`（按月字符串）；`product_origin` 的多值写法（不能当单值产地） |
| 数字来源 | 正文所有数字来自本页 prep chunk 的同一份聚合；内联数字一律经 `sprintf` / `format` 定型，避开 knitr 对大数的科学计数法改写 |
| 不画的东西 | 不画价格-真伪散点（n = 22 且三组价格区间重叠，散点会诱导读出一条不存在的斜率）；不画品牌排名（两表都没有品牌列）；不画混淆矩阵 / 分类器（22 瓶 + 6 个非纯样本，任何训练都会过拟合）；不画时间趋势（只有 2020 与 2026 两个点） |

```{r}
#| label: typography-audit
#| include: false
audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tt_audit(fig1) |> mutate(图 = "图 1", .before = 1),
  tt_audit(fig2) |> mutate(图 = "图 2", .before = 1),
  tt_audit(fig3) |> mutate(图 = "图 3", .before = 1)
)
n_size_used <- dplyr::n_distinct(audit$size[!is.na(audit$size)])
n_family    <- dplyr::n_distinct(audit$family[!is.na(audit$family)])
n_off       <- sum(!audit$in_ladder)
stopifnot(n_size_used <= TT_TYPE_MAX, n_family <= TT_FAMILY_MAX, n_off == 0)
cat(sprintf("typo-audit: sizes %d/%d, families %d/%d, off-ladder %d\n",
            n_size_used, TT_TYPE_MAX, n_family, TT_FAMILY_MAX, n_off), file = stderr())
cat(sprintf("join-check: shared_marker_cols %d, shared_key %d, brand_cols %d\n",
            shared_marker_cols, n_shared_key, n_brand_cols), file = stderr())
```
